name: Kick
author: Emilie Gillet
description: Braids' self-enveloping kick: two decaying pulses into a bandpass that jumps up in pitch for a brief click, then self-brightens. A different mechanism from Plaits' own analog-bass-drum, which clicks with FM rather than a retuned filter.

controls.label: Tone
controls.description: The output filter's brightness -- Braids' COLOR, applied after the resonator.

controls.label: Decay
controls.description: The resonator's decay -- Braids' TIMBRE. Turning it up lengthens the boom toward near-self-oscillation.

controls.label: Balance
controls.description: Crossfades the two excitation pulses. Centred is native level; the ends fade one out to just click or just thump.

controls.label: Punch
controls.description: Scales the self-brightening dynamic filter modulation around the module's one fixed amount, from off to 4x.

outputs.aux: The raw excitation pulses, before the resonator, soft-clipped.
